messages:
Alice Chen: Hey @devex — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 to update the Python quickstart. Mostly examples + a small SDK surface change (kwargs for client.create). Can someone glance for correctness + copy edits? CI is currently failing on linting, expect one small formatting fix. Thanks! :pray:

Marco Rivera: Taking a look now. Quick q: you changed Client.create -> Client.create_completion? the import in snippet still shows `from redwood import Client` but call uses `client.create`. I'll run tests.

docs-ci-bot: CI check failed — docs-lint (flake8) — 1 error. Details: https://ci.redwood/run/482

Marco Rivera: yep the snippet triggers flake8 E203 in example.py line 12. Suggest running `black` before pushing. I'll push a tiny fix to your branch unless you want to.

Alice Chen: that would be great, thanks. I didn't run formatters — go ahead.

Jenna Patel: I can do content pass for phrasing and headings later today. @Samir can you double-check the new kwargs names match the SDK release notes?

Samir Ahmed: will check SDK surface. If it's a breaking change we need a migration note. Looks like a non-breaking alias. I'll confirm by EOD.

Marco Rivera: pushed formatting fix and updated the example import to `client.create_completion(...)` — CI requeued.

docs-ci-bot: CI check passed — all checks green.

Jenna Patel: Quick nit: "install latest SDK" -> "install the latest SDK (vX.Y.Z)" — small suggestion, I'll submit a commit.

Alice Chen: Awesome, thanks everyone. If no other concerns I'll merge after Samir confirms by 5pm PT. :shipit:

Samir Ahmed: confirmed, alias accepted. No migration required. Approved.

Alice Chen: merging now.

Alice Chen: merged commit 0a1b2c4 — PR closed. Thanks all!
